operators.name: linear_celu
semantics: Computes linear transformation: y = x @ weight.T + bias, using the actual weight and bias tensors provided.
Then applies CELU activation elementwise: celu(y) = max(0, y) + min(0, alpha * (exp(y / alpha) - 1)), with alpha = 1.0.
Input x has shape [batch_size, in_features], weight has shape [out_features, in_features], bias has shape [out_features].
Output has shape [batch_size, out_features], dtype torch.float32, device cuda.
Equivalent to reference statement: return self.celu(self.linear(x))
self.linear(x) applies F.linear with weight and bias, output shape [batch_size, out_features].
self.celu applies CELU with alpha=1.0 elementwise, preserving shape and dtype.
